source:
# Port of lib/pubid/jcgm/parser.rb: JCGM base, meeting, amendment and
# corrigendum identifiers, and the named GUM/VIM guides.

grammar PubidJcgm version "0.1.0" {
  century = "19" / "20"
  year_digits = century 2*digit !digit
  month_digits = 2*digit
  day_digits = 2*digit
  digits = 1*digit
  publisher = "JCGM" as publisher
  ordinal_suffix = "st" / "nd" / "rd" / "th"
  gum_number = "GUM-" (1*digit) as gum_number
  standard_number = digits as number
  number_portion = gum_number / standard_number
  full_date = (year_digits dash month_digits dash day_digits) as date
  year_only = year_digits as date
  date_portion = colon (full_date / year_only)
  language_portion = "(" (("E/F" / "F/E") / upper) as languages ")"
  base = publisher space number_portion [date_portion] [language_portion]
  meeting_identifier = publisher space digits as number ordinal_suffix space "Meeting" as type_with_stage [(space "(" year_digits as date ")")]
  amendment_identifier = (base as base) slash "Amd" as type_with_stage (space / ("." [space])) digits as number [(colon (full_date / year_only))]
  corrigendum_identifier = (base as base) space "Corrigendum" as type_with_stage
  numbered_corrigendum_identifier = (base as base) slash "Cor" as type_with_stage (space / ("." [space])) digits as number [(colon (full_date / year_only))]
  named_number = ("GUM" / ("VIM" [(dash digits)])) as number
  named_guide_identifier = publisher space named_number
  identifier = meeting_identifier / amendment_identifier / corrigendum_identifier / numbered_corrigendum_identifier / base / named_guide_identifier
  upper = %x41-5A
  digit = %x30-39
  slash = "/"
  dash = "-"
  colon = ":"
  space = " "
  entry identifier: identifier

  test {
    accept "JCGM 200:2008(F)"
    accept "JCGM 100:2008"
    accept "JCGM 1st Meeting (2004)"
    accept "JCGM 100:2008/Amd.1:2026"
    accept "JCGM 101:2008/Cor.1:2009"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
